source: FF Waiver Deep Dive | Week 7 usage + Oct 27-28 2026 waiver/injury updates | CBS, NFL.com, Yahoo, NBC, Richard league context

players.name: Jonah Coleman
players.note: Richard has No.1 waiver priority and Coleman is available. Returned from IR and led Denver RBs with 9-54 rushing plus 2-15 receiving; Sean Payton said he needs more touches. Priority add over current fringe bench options.

players.name: Rachaad White
players.note: Available in Richard's league. Jacory Croskey-Merritt on IR leaves White with at least several games of elevated work. Week 6 without JCM: 7-27 rushing, 4-30-1 receiving on 5 targets. Strong half-PPR add, but committee caps ceiling.

players.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
players.note: Richard's league shows him available. Back-to-back 100-yard TD games; 11-218-2 across Weeks 6-7. Prefer for ceiling over lower-upside veteran WRs; some efficiency regression likely.

players.name: KC Concepcion
players.note: Available in Richard's league. Week 7 8-129 on 10 targets plus 3-23 rushing; six-plus targets in five of six games. Safer repeatable volume than one-week TD spikes.

players.name: Malik Willis
players.note: Richard needs a Week 8 QB with Stroud on bye. Willis has topped 20.9 fantasy points in two straight and adds rushing floor: 110 rush yards and 2 rush TDs across those games. Preferred upside streamer from current available QB pool.

players.name: Michael Penix Jr.
players.note: Available fallback to Willis. Strong recent passing form and favorable Tampa matchup; lower rushing floor than Willis.

players.name: Baker Mayfield
players.note: Available Week 8 streamer with favorable Atlanta matchup and another useful matchup in Week 9. Lower ceiling than Willis but stable contingency.

players.name: Geno Smith
players.note: Available and coming off a strong Week 7, but recent volatility keeps him behind Willis/Penix. Las Vegas matchup is favorable.

players.name: C.J. Stroud
players.note: Richard owns. Houston is on Week 8 bye. Do not leave him as the only QB this week. Can be swapped for a preferred ROS QB if roster space demands it.

players.name: Jaylen Waddle
players.note: Richard owns. Re-aggravated prior chest injury; Week 8 status depends on practice participation. Use as contingency cut for White or Week 8 QB if needed, but do not drop automatically if he returns to full practice.

players.name: Denzel Boston
players.note: Richard owns. Still has downfield opportunity but lower weekly floor than Cooper or Concepcion. Reasonable drop if adding either breakout WR.

players.name: Woody Marks
players.note: Richard owns. Week 8 bye does not make him expendable; preserve over routine waiver churn.

players.name: Ollie Gordon II
players.note: Richard owns and should remain a core RB. Do not use as waiver drop.

players.name: Zach Charbonnet
players.note: Richard owns. Questionable/knee; preserve for upside unless later ruled out long term. Not the first cut for White.

players.name: Dylan Sampson
players.note: Richard had him in IR but he returned to play; with only three bench slots, he is the expendable asset to clear IR mechanics for Coleman.

players.name: Alvin Kamara
players.note: Richard owns and is on Week 8 bye. With Coleman available and Sampson needing to leave IR, Kamara is the preferred active-roster cut.

players.name: Caleb Douglas
players.note: Available in Richard's league. Two Week 7 TDs on only three targets; role is interesting but target volume is less trustworthy than Cooper/Concepcion.

players.name: Bengals D/ST
players.note: Preferred Week 8 D/ST stream over Tennessee; strong sack profile and favorable Titans matchup.
